title: A finding that reproduces at the base is matched against existing findings and ticks before it is drafted
body: In yoh, the same host-dependent runstate maintenance fixture failure was drafted as a separate finding by nine ticks (all later promoted to pqs), and 9iz re-drafted b1t's wall-bound gap. Each duplicate costs a triage step on a run that is meant to be unattended. Keying findings on the failing test or symbol and suppressing re-drafts of an open one would remove that load.
